label: Player Sensor
description: A sensor that emits redstone when players are in a configured area.

config.name: channel
config.label: Channel
config.description: The channel all other computers controlling this sensor should communicate on.

config.name: role
config.label: Role
config.description: Should this computer sense, emit or both?

config.name: setupChannel
config.label: Setup Channel
config.description: The channel used to communicate with the setup pocket computer.

config.name: redstoneLingerDuration
config.label: Redstone Linger Duration
config.description: The time in seconds that the redstone output should remain powered after a player leaves the configured area.

config.name: redstoneOutputSide
config.label: Redstone Output Side
config.description: The side of the computer the redstone output should be emitted on.
